issue.title: rsyslog service restart during eventd service start causes failures

failure.body:
#### Description

Rsyslog service restart by eventd service causes service start failures:

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Reboot

#### Describe the results you received:

```
2024 Oct 15 <IPV6>.682673 sonic NOTICE admin: Starting bgp service...
2024 Oct 15 <IPV6>.712769 sonic NOTICE admin: Warm boot flag: bgp true.
2024 Oct 15 <IPV6>.718818 sonic NOTICE admin: Fast boot flag: bgp .
2024 Oct 15 <IPV6>.781090 sonic INFO systemd[1]: rsyslog.service: Deactivated successfully.

2024 Oct 15 <IPV6>.822264 sonic INFO systemd[1]: Starting rsyslog.service - System Logging Service...
2024 Oct 15 <IPV6>.825426 sonic NOTICE systemd[1]: rsyslog.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=1/FAILURE
2024 Oct 15 <IPV6>.825539 sonic WARNING systemd[1]: rsyslog.service: Failed with result 'exit-code'.

2024 Oct 15 <IPV6>.827440 sonic ERR systemctl[6191]: Job for rsyslog.service failed because the control process exited with error code.
2024 Oct 15 <IPV6>.827512 sonic ERR systemctl[6191]: See "systemctl status rsyslog.service" and "journalctl -xeu rsyslog.service" for details.

2024 Oct 15 <IPV6>.829152 sonic WARNING systemd[1]: eventd.service: Failed with result 'exit-code'.
2024 Oct 15 <IPV6>.829769 sonic ERR systemd[1]: Failed to start eventd.service - EVENTD container.
2024 Oct 15 <IPV6>.880062 sonic INFO bgp.sh[6707]: Starting existing bgp container with HWSKU Mellanox-SN4700-O8V48

2024 Oct 15 <IPV6>.091220 sonic INFO systemd[1]: Stopped rsyslog.service - System Logging Service.
```
